exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Want someone to do something".

options.text: Verb て ほしい
A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb て ほしい matches "Want someone to do something".

exercises.explanation: Expresses wanting someone else to do an action for you.
